game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Net Menders' Pier Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round, pirate raiders strike the harbor gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor gate from pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier: keep the cover meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: cover drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
